title: Projection-normalized equivariant adic realization data
statement: For the finite and sheaf data of [def-sfb-equivariant-adic-fibre-data], and the algebraic realization data of [def-sfb-equivariant-adic-fibre-coordinates], define normalized realization data as follows. The actual fibre $Q$ is finite free, with compatible bases of every finite quotient and an isomorphism $Q\simeq A^d$ inducing those bases on all coordinate projections; this is a homeomorphism and the ideals $\varpi^nQ$, $n>0$, form the zero-neighborhood basis. Each actual projection is surjective with kernel $\varpi^{n+1}Q$. Specify the jointly continuous coordinate action on Q and its E-linear extension on $M=E\otimes_AQ$, jointly continuous in the finite-dimensional norm topology and fixed on every pure tensor. Give continuous module presentations for Q and M [def-sfb-continuous-module-section-model], internal module isomorphisms $u^*N\simeq p_X^*C(-,Q)$ and $u^*(N[1/\varpi])\simeq p_X^*C(-,M)$, all integral reductions equal to the prescribed finite charts, and the actual full-parameter descent arrows equal to those actions. Normalize the integral-to-rational comparison by the actual extension-of-scalars unit and q mapping to $1\otimes q$ on every profinite section. This defines realization data; no existence is asserted here.
